digest.component_or_area: plan-review gate on edit/claim CLI verbs
propositions: Add a valueless --review flag to edit that runs a signed review_plan after the EDIT commits, mapping the verdict to exit codes 0/1/2/11.
Add a --review flag to claim that senses gate applicability, reviews only when the gate applies and claim_gate_check is not-ok, and claims only on PASS.
The bare --review flag must parse without consuming the following argv token.
On BLOCK/INDETERMINATE/retryable-degrade the claim core is never invoked and the command exits 1/2/11 with the review summary printed.
The store flock is never held while the multi-minute review runs; edit/claim appends its event under a short lock, releases, then reviews.
A raising review_plan propagates through the standard CLI error path, leaving the edit committed and the claim never attempted.
